name: summoner
description: Summoner — AI Agent Orchestration Framework. Portable, project-agnostic workflow orchestration with checkpoint-based interruption and post-game review. Like a Makefile for AI workflows: framework verbs are fixed, project skills are replaceable.
author: Jingshan Xue

skills.name: summoner
skills.description: Routes user intent through summoner.yaml manifest to domain skills. Enforces checkpoint protocol and post-game review. Use when user invokes any /summoner:* command or expresses intent matching a Summoner workflow.

skills.name: summoner-setup
skills.description: Initialize Summoner for this project (one-command setup). Use when user says 'setup summoner', 'initialize summoner', or asks how to use Summoner in this project.

skills.name: summoner-release
skills.description: Version release automation — version planning, changelog generation, release execution. Keeps ALL THREE version manifests synchronized (root plugin.json, .claude-plugin/plugin.json, .claude-plugin/marketplace.json). Use when user invokes /summoner:release.

skills.name: auto-setup-summoner
skills.description: Configure a v2 Summoner capability map when the user explicitly requests setup or asks how to resolve a missing-manifest warning; never auto-initialize solely because SessionStart reports missing configuration.

skills.name: phase-submit
skills.description: ONLY to submit a completed phase result — invoke when a phase's work is done; never for anything else. Not user-invocable; it is the main session's single submission channel to the checkpoint protocol.

skills.name: change
skills.description: ONLY to open or apply a requirement change in a live Summoner run; never for anything else. Not user-invocable; it is the main session's single channel into the requirement-change loop (open freezes the development position, apply submits the delta + impact).

skills.name: review-submit
skills.description: ONLY to register one review envelope in a live Summoner run (REVIEW_PENDING); never for anything else. Not user-invocable; it is the main session's single envelope-registration channel (validates against the frozen acceptance view minus drops, consumes the [v] obligation, prepares the review).

skills.name: probe-submit
skills.description: ONLY to resolve an OUTCOME_UNKNOWN episode of a live Summoner run; never for anything else. Not user-invocable; it is the main session's single crash-recovery channel (one observed read-class probe per unresolved outcome, validated against the run's trace before any transition).

agents.name: code-reviewer
agents.description: Senior Staff Engineer — 5-axis code review (correctness, idiom, architecture, security, impact)

agents.name: security-auditor
agents.description: Security Engineer — OWASP Top 10 vulnerability audit, secrets handling, dependency analysis

agents.name: test-engineer
agents.description: QA Engineer — test strategy, coverage analysis, Prove-It pattern for bug fixes

agents.name: debug-agent
agents.description: Root Cause Analyst — systematic error diagnosis, stack trace analysis, log correlation, hypothesis-driven debugging

agents.name: reviewer
agents.description: Single-loop ⑤ reviewer — independent black-box re-derivation of one artifact set against a frozen acceptance envelope; returns a structured ReviewResult with evidence_tool_call_ids (a PASS with empty evidence is a rubber-stamp protocol error)

commands.name: summoner:fix
commands.description: Bug fix full pipeline: context → diagnosis (iron law) → reproduce → fix → regression → review, each phase closing at a user-verified checkpoint. DEFAULT for 排查-type phrases ('帮我排查这个 bug') — route here unless the user explicitly wants diagnosis only (then /summoner:debug). Triggers: '线上报错', '帮我排查这个 bug 并修好', '登录失败了修一下'

commands.name: summoner:new
commands.description: New feature full pipeline: context → requirements → plan → implement → verify → review, each phase closing at a user-verified checkpoint. Triggers: '新增一个子系统', 'add knight mode feature', '加一个排行榜功能'

commands.name: summoner:ship
commands.description: Pre-launch review: one independent reviewer over the full rubric → merge report → go/no-go. Sensitive changes add criteria, not reviewers. Triggers: '准备发版', 'review before merge', '上线前检查'

commands.name: summoner:debug
commands.description: Diagnose ONLY — root cause analysis without making changes. Use when the user explicitly wants the cause and no code changes ('先别改代码', '只告诉我原因', '我自己来修'); otherwise 排查-type phrases default to /summoner:fix. Triggers: '帮我看下这个报错是什么原因，先别改', '这个 nil pointer 哪里来的'

commands.name: summoner:ops
commands.description: Ops operations routed through project's ops skill. Triggers: '启动服务', '重启', '查看状态'

commands.name: summoner:review
commands.description: Standalone code review via the verification_spec route — one independent reviewer, no code changes. Triggers: 'review 一下这个改动', '帮我看看这段代码有什么问题'

commands.name: summoner:release
commands.description: Version release workflow: version planning → changelog → release execution. Triggers: '发版', 'release 0.1.x', 'publish a new version'

commands.name: summoner:status
commands.description: Read-only status view of the current run — phase route, pending checkpoint, budget, sandbox tier. Renders via hooks/bin/summoner-status; never mutates state. Triggers: '当前进度', 'run status', '检查点状态'
